emailEntry.title: Join the interview
emailEntry.subtitle: Enter your email to receive a link and continue on any device.
emailEntry.enterEmailDesc: Enter your email to get your 6-digit code. It arrives in seconds and you stay right on this page.
emailEntry.emailNote: Verifying your email is how we know one person takes the study once. It also saves your progress if you need to pause, and lets us send a short confirmation when you finish. No marketing, ever.
emailEntry.sendError: We couldn't send your code. Please check your email address and try again.
emailEntry.resendError: We couldn't send a new code. Please try again.
emailEntry.trustLine: Your responses are encrypted and stored securely.
emailEntry.whyEmailToggle: Why we ask for your email
emailEntry.whyEmailBody: Verifying your email keeps each person to one interview, which is what keeps the results trustworthy for the research team. It also lets you pause and pick the interview back up from any device, and we send a short confirmation once you finish. We won't add you to any list, invitations to future studies only ever happen if you explicitly opt in.

emailSent.title: Enter your code
emailSent.codeWhy: Typing the code keeps you in this tab, where your microphone is already set up. That is the smoothest way to run the interview.
emailSent.expiry: The code is valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if the email is not there yet.
emailSent.codeResent: New code sent. It replaces the previous one.
emailSent.linkAlternative: The same email also has a link you can tap. It may open the study in a different window, so the code is the smoother option.
emailSent.errorInvalid: That code is not right, check the email and try again.
emailSent.errorExpired: That code has expired or has already been used. Send yourself a new one.
emailSent.errorLocked: Too many incorrect attempts. Send a new code to continue.
emailSent.errorGeneric: We couldn't check that code. Please try again.

micPrompt.title: This interview uses your microphone
micPrompt.subtitle: When you click below, your browser will ask for microphone permission. Click Allow, this is required to record your answers.

micPrompt.step3: Say something to confirm your mic is working
micPrompt.note: Your audio is only recorded when you actively press the record button.

micTest.title: Quick mic check
micTest.desc: Say anything to test your microphone before we begin.
micTest.descClear: Say a few words out loud, just so we know your mic is working.

micTest.listening: We can hear you, keep going
micTest.permissionDeniedDesc: This interview requires microphone access. Please allow it in your browser settings, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedIOS: On iPhone/iPad, go to Settings → Safari → Microphone and allow access for this website.
micTest.permissionDeniedChrome: Click the camera icon in the address bar → Allow microphone, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedSafari: Go to Settings → Safari → Microphone → Allow for this website, then refresh.
micTest.permissionDeniedFirefox: Click the lock icon in the address bar → Permissions → Microphone → Allow, then refresh.
